threat_event: Ransomware encrypts business IT (email, file shares, ERP, measurement access) and leadership orders a precautionary pipeline shutdown because OT trust cannot be confirmed quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT monitoring missing at 3 stations and field sites; live IT/OT isolation never performed; shutdown criteria not tied to the BIA
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MSSP; immutable cloud backups; IT/OT firewall pairs and DMZ; TSA incident response plan exercised yearly
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 operate-or-shut-down criteria into the Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan; perform a live DMZ isolation drill; extend OT monitoring to all stations
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$8M (reservation credits up to $252K a day, response, restart; insurance limit $20M)

threat_event: Attacker uses stolen staff or vendor credentials on the remote access gateway to reach SCADA servers and HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway relies on identity provider MFA; vendor session approval depends on the shift supervisor; 9 OT domain administrators against a target of 4
existing_controls: MFA, approval per vendor session, session recording, MSSP alerting on off-window sessions
treatment_plan: Reduce OT administrators to 4; phishing-resistant authenticators for all gateway users; monthly review of session recordings

threat_event: Attacker reaches a compressor unit control panel through the OEM remote diagnostics cellular modem and changes unit settings or disables the unit (found in P07 testing)
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state actor scanning cellular address space
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Undocumented OEM cellular modem connected to a unit control panel at Compressor Station 4, outside the DMZ and the TSA plan; OEM contract has no security terms
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 at Compressor Station 4 (and possibly Stations 2 and 5); BP-02
existing_controls: Hardwired ESD independent of PLC logic; station technicians on site during the day
treatment_plan: Disconnect the modem (done 2026-08-13, temporary); survey all 14 units; route OEM data through the DMZ to the OT analytics account; OEM contract security terms

threat_event: SCADA servers at both the GCC and the BCC are encrypted or wiped, and a full rebuild from backup takes longer than the 8-hour MTD
threat_source: Cybercriminal ransomware group with OT capability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full rebuild from backup not tested in 12 months; same OT domain spans both control centers
existing_controls: Monthly offline SCADA backups at the BCC; hot-standby BCC; manual operation plan
treatment_plan: Annual bare-metal rebuild test on spare servers; separate BCC administrative credentials; hash-checked restore procedure

threat_event: A nation-state actor pre-positions in OT at an unmonitored compressor station or field site using legitimate tools and is not detected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT monitoring at Compressor Stations 2, 4, and 5 or field sites; no field telecommunications baseline; OT logs kept 90 days
existing_controls: Sensors at 4 sites; MSSP 24x7; CISA and TSA advisories reviewed weekly
treatment_plan: Sensors at the 3 remaining stations; telecom traffic baseline; OT logs to the 12-month archive
exposure_estimate_usd: Hard to bound; supports any of R-002 to R-011

threat_event: Unattributable or unauthorized change on a station HMI using the shared station login
threat_source: Insider or outsider with station access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared operator login per station at Compressor Stations 2, 4, and 5 (12 HMIs); password not changed when technicians leave
existing_controls: Badge access and CCTV at station control buildings
treatment_plan: Individual logins on replacement HMIs; interim password change at every departure and every 90 days

threat_event: Attacker with access to the carrier private network logs into field RTUs or gateways with passwords past their reset schedule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 40% of field devices past the TSA plan reset schedule; mitigation timeframe expired 2026-06-30
existing_controls: Carrier private network; field devices not reachable from the internet
treatment_plan: Reset program by area with field crews; documented mitigations per device type; new timeframe filed with TSA

threat_event: Attacker exploits one of the 6 CISA KEV vulnerabilities on OT components that are past the mitigation timeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly OT patch cycle; vendor qualification delays; 6 KEV entries overdue
existing_controls: Patch strategy with KEV priority; segmentation; allowlisting at control centers
treatment_plan: Clear the 6 KEV items or document mitigations with timelines; monthly KEV review with Gas Control

threat_event: Malware runs on one of the 14 unsupported station HMIs, introduced by an OEM laptop or USB drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating system past end of support; no allowlisting on station HMIs; OEM laptops plugged in without a scan at 2 stations
existing_controls: USB scanning kiosks at all stations; station HMIs isolated on a station VLAN
treatment_plan: Replace the 14 HMIs; until then, allowlisting and scan-before-connect for all visitor laptops

threat_event: Leaders order an unnecessary or prolonged shutdown, or delay a needed one, because the decision criteria are not tied to the BIA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 tabletop showed executives defaulting to shutdown; no written criteria in the incident response plan
existing_controls: Emergency plan (192.615) for safety-driven shutdowns; experienced Director of Gas Control
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 decision tree; executive tabletop with the board chair; criteria in the emergency plan cyber annex
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.3M per 5 days of shutdown in credits, plus customer and public harm

threat_event: An attacker manipulates SCADA values or commands so controllers act on false data (false data injection)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No device authentication on legacy serial protocols; microwave backbone unencrypted; command anomaly detection only at 4 sites
existing_controls: Field verification by radio; controller training on false data (3 cyber AOCs); hardwired ESD
treatment_plan: Command anomaly detection at all stations; encryption of the microwave backbone; field verification step in runbook 2

threat_event: A compromised SCADA vendor update or support package introduces malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA software vendor has no SOC 2 report; updates checked only by hash from the vendor portal
existing_controls: Updates tested on the development server; release notes reviewed
treatment_plan: Vendor security assessment; offline malware scan and staged deployment of every update

threat_event: The MSSP EDR or orchestration console is compromised and used to push malware to business endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP has privileged agents on all business endpoints; MSSP has no OT access by design
existing_controls: MSSP SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed; MSSP has no OT access; MFA for MSSP staff
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 and CUEC review; contract notice within 24 hours; quarterly review of MSSP admin roles

threat_event: A carrier cellular outage cuts SCADA visibility at many of the 41 cellular-only field sites at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One cellular carrier; satellite backup at 12 critical sites only
existing_controls: Satellite backup at 12 sites; field crews can read local gauges
treatment_plan: Second-carrier SIMs at the 15 largest delivery points; carrier contract with outage notice

threat_event: A hurricane disables the GCC (power, flooding, or access) during peak operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GCC in Florida; BCC about 90 miles away may be in the same storm path
existing_controls: Hot-standby BCC; generators; pre-storm staffing plan
treatment_plan: Pre-landfall transfer to the BCC as standard practice; test BCC operation for 72 hours

threat_event: An intruder at an unmanned M&R station or valve site tampers with an RTU or local panel
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote sites locked and alarmed, but response time can exceed 1 hour
existing_controls: Intrusion alarms to the GCC; locks; patrols
treatment_plan: Tamper alarms on RTU cabinets at the 20 largest M&R stations

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a shipper refund or a vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment change requests accepted by email at 2 area offices
existing_controls: Email filtering; MFA; call-back rule at headquarters
treatment_plan: Call-back verification at all offices; payment change workflow in the ERP

threat_event: Phishing and MFA prompt fatigue give an attacker an identity provider account that can reach the remote access gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA with number matching for most users; security keys only for administrators
existing_controls: Number matching; conditional access; gateway approval per vendor session
treatment_plan: Security keys for all gateway users

threat_event: The customer activities website is unavailable or compromised during a gas day, disrupting nominations and FERC postings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS vendor; no SOC 2 reviewed; manual fallback untested since 2024
existing_controls: Phone and spreadsheet nominations procedure; vendor DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Obtain and review the vendor SOC 2; test manual nominations each year

threat_event: A breach at the customer activities website vendor exposes shipper contract data or allows false postings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor controls unverified
existing_controls: Contract confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Breach notice term (24 hours) at renewal; SOC 2 review

threat_event: A departed employee uses OT or SCADA access in the days before removal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT account removal averages 5 business days; shared station passwords not changed
existing_controls: Badge disabled on day 1; gateway access through the identity provider ends on day 1
treatment_plan: HR termination ticket triggers same-day OT removal; quarterly OT access review

threat_event: A privileged insider changes SCADA configuration maliciously and approves the change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two SCADA engineers can change and approve their own changes in the change tool
existing_controls: MOC sign-off by the Director of Gas Control; change history
treatment_plan: Enforce two-person approval in the change tool

threat_event: A vendor with access but without contract security terms has an incident that reaches company data or systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 40% of 85 vendors with access lack security terms; 10 of 14 Tier 1 vendors unreviewed
existing_controls: Vendor register with tiers; security addendum for new OT purchases
treatment_plan: Security addendum at renewal for all Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors; complete Tier 1 reviews

threat_event: The microwave backbone between the GCC and a compressor station fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single microwave path to 2 stations
existing_controls: MPLS backup path; local station operation
treatment_plan: Accepted: MPLS backup and local operation keep the risk within appetite; review at the 2027 telecom refresh

threat_event: The leak-detection model misses a small leak, or its false alerts lead controllers to ignore it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Detection below target for small leaks; false alert rate above target; weaker on cellular-only segments (P10)
existing_controls: Advisory only; SCADA alarms primary; patrols and surveys continue
treatment_plan: Retune thresholds; coverage indicator; monthly performance report (P10)

threat_event: The right-of-way imagery change detection service misses an encroachment or excavation near the pipeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor model; detection rates for small equipment not validated locally
existing_controls: Aerial and ground patrols continue at required intervals; one-call system
treatment_plan: Local validation on 6 months of patrol findings (P10 AI-003)
exposure_estimate_usd: Safety consequence if patrols were reduced

threat_event: The model vendor changes the leak-detection model without notice and alert behavior changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor deploys directly to production; no MOC; not in the TSA plan
existing_controls: Contract security terms (2025)
treatment_plan: Staging slot; revalidation; Director of Gas Control approval through MOC

threat_event: Staff paste SSI, SCADA configurations, or network diagrams into a public generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enterprise AI assistant only in pilot; public tools not blocked
existing_controls: POL-05 rule; awareness training
treatment_plan: Block public AI tools on company devices once the enterprise assistant is approved (P10 AI-004)

threat_event: SSI (TSA plans, assessment results) is disclosed to people without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unmarked copies on a general file share; SSI repository access not reviewed
existing_controls: SSI procedure; restricted repository
treatment_plan: Remove and mark copies; data loss rule for SSI markings; annual SSI training for covered staff

threat_event: TSA finds the company out of compliance (plan amendments not filed; assessment schedule behind; reset mitigations expired)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two permanent changes not filed within 50 days; 28% of measures assessed against one-third
existing_controls: Coordinator relationship with TSA; annual report process
treatment_plan: File the 2 amendment requests by 2026-10-31; complete the year-one assessment schedule before the 2026-11-20 report

threat_event: A field device missing from the inventory is missed in patching or incident response
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field inventory about 85% complete; firmware unknown for about 20%
existing_controls: Annual field audit by area
treatment_plan: Complete inventory with field crews and sensor discovery

threat_event: A temporary troubleshooting rule on a DMZ firewall is left in place and bypasses segmentation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rules have owners and review dates, but temporary rules have no automatic expiry
existing_controls: Quarterly rule review
treatment_plan: Automatic expiry for temporary rules; weekly report of rules younger than 30 days

threat_event: Malware on a contractor USB drive or laptop infects an engineering workstation at a control center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosks in place; contractors sometimes bypass at stations
existing_controls: USB kiosks; allowlisting at control centers
treatment_plan: Scan-before-connect enforced at stations; contractor laptop attestation

threat_event: A slow intrusion in OT cannot be investigated because OT logs are kept only 90 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT logs 90 days in the SIEM; field device logs not collected
existing_controls: SIEM retention 90 days
treatment_plan: Route OT logs to the 12-month write-once archive

threat_event: An attacker with cloud administrator rights deletes business workload backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Write-once retention with separate credentials
existing_controls: Write-once 35-day retention; separate administrators; guardrails
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test including the OT analytics account

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes GIS or integrity data that would be CEII if filed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GIS data in object storage
existing_controls: Guardrails block public buckets; posture monitoring
treatment_plan: Monthly posture review; Restricted labels on GIS buckets

threat_event: Employee personal information is stolen during a ransomware attack and must be notified in 3 states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR files on file shares; payroll SaaS
regulatory_driver: None binding (state breach laws; Fla. Stat. 501.171 as worked example)
existing_controls: EDR; MFA; payroll vendor controls
treatment_plan: Move HR files to the HR SaaS; egress alerts on file shares

threat_event: PLC logic at Compressor Stations 2, 4, or 5 is lost or altered and cannot be restored quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No PLC logic backups at 3 stations
existing_controls: OEM and integrator hold some program copies
treatment_plan: Collect and hash PLC logic at all stations; store offline at the BCC

threat_event: Compressor station technicians respond slowly or wrongly to a cyber-caused abnormal condition at a station
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station technicians have no OT security training
existing_controls: Controllers trained on 3 cyber AOCs
treatment_plan: Station technician module and joint exercise with controllers

threat_event: A SCADA change without point-to-point verification shows a controller a wrong value
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 25 sampled changes lacked P2P records (P07)
existing_controls: MOC process; P2P procedure
treatment_plan: Block release in the change tool until the P2P record is attached

threat_event: The company fails to notify a lateral owner within 30 minutes during an incident and owes credits or loses the contract
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OSA notice step not in the incident plan before P08
existing_controls: Shift supervisor checklist
treatment_plan: Add OSA notices to both P08 runbooks and the shift checklist

threat_event: A denial of service attack on internet circuits or the customer activities website
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor and carrier DDoS protection
existing_controls: Carrier and vendor DDoS protection; OT does not depend on the internet
treatment_plan: Accepted: provider protections and manual nominations keep the risk Low

threat_event: An intruder enters the GCC or BCC control room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Badge access, CCTV, staffed 24x7
existing_controls: Badge access; CCTV; staffed rooms
treatment_plan: Annual physical security test; visitor escort audit

threat_event: The GPS time source fails or is spoofed, disrupting log correlation and SCADA event order
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two GPS sources; no holdover alarm
existing_controls: Two GPS sources at the GCC and BCC
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; add holdover alarm at next upgrade

threat_event: A field tablet with maps and saved credentials is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 260 tablets in the field
existing_controls: Encryption; remote wipe; no OT access
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: encryption and remote wipe

threat_event: A cybersecurity incident is not reported to CISA within 72 hours because the Coordinator and alternates are unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coordinator and 2 alternates; no tested rota for holidays
existing_controls: Coordinator on call 24x7; 2 reports in 2025-2026 within 24 hours
treatment_plan: Published on-call rota with the MSSP as reminder service; quarterly contact test

threat_event: Loss of one of the 2 OT Security Engineers leaves OT monitoring and access tasks uncovered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small OT security team
existing_controls: Cross-training with SCADA engineers
treatment_plan: Documented runbooks; MSSP OT service option; third OT security role in the FY2027 budget

threat_event: A breach of the SCADA vendor support environment exposes company SCADA configurations or remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 from the SCADA vendor; vendor holds configuration backups
existing_controls: Gateway-only access; contract with 24-hour incident notice
treatment_plan: Vendor security assessment; limit configuration copies held by the vendor

threat_event: Traffic on the unencrypted microwave backbone is intercepted or altered by an attacker with RF or tower access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Microwave links not encrypted
existing_controls: Licensed frequencies; locked tower sites
treatment_plan: Link encryption at the 2027 microwave refresh

threat_event: The company pays a ransom to a sanctioned party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pressure to restore during a shutdown
regulatory_driver: None binding (OFAC advisory, 31 CFR ch. V)
existing_controls: POL-03 requires an OFAC check, counsel, insurer, and CEO and board chair approval
treatment_plan: No payment without the OFAC check and approvals (POL-03 4.8)

threat_event: A shipper account on the customer activities website is phished and used to submit false nominations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shipper administrators manage their own users; MFA optional for shippers
existing_controls: Confirmation step with interconnecting operators
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all shipper accounts
